summary: Judge murdered by the 'Ndrangheta; same-surname figure from the comune next to San Mango d'Aquino, no proven kinship.
bio:
Born in Conflenti, next to San Mango d'Aquino. Investigating judge and later appeals-court president; murdered by the 'Ndrangheta in Lamezia Terme in 1975; commemorated by President Mattarella. Ferlaino is a small Savuto-valley surname, so a distant link is plausible but unproven.

Italian Wikipedia gives his birth as 23 July 1914 at Conflenti ([R4-S1]). He was a magistrate and was shot dead on 3 July 1975 near his home in Nicastro (Lamezia Terme). He was the paternal uncle of Corrado Ferlaino, the SSC Napoli owner (living; not researched). No genealogical link to John's San Mango Ferlainos was found.
